name: Gasthof Wilder Kaiser
beschreibung:
Located in the heart of the Wilder Kaiser region, this established inn in Scheffau features comfortable rooms and wholesome regional cuisine using local ingredients. It is a fantastic hub for hikers and skiers.

The SkiWelt cable cars, Lake Hintersteiner See, and mountain trails are only moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Wilder Kaiser in Scheffau brings together traditional Tyrolean cuisine and warm alpine hospitality.
